data.fund_type: An open ended debt scheme predominantly investing in AA+ and above rated corporate bonds. A relatively high interest rate riskand moderate credit risk.
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the Scheme is to seek to generate regular income and capital appreciation commensuratewith risk from a portfolio predominantly investing in corporate debt securities across maturities which are rated AA+ and above,in addition to debt instruments issued by central and state governments and money market securities. There is no assurance thatthe investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
